CustomField.description: Org-wide maximum of admitted top-level instances for all definitions together (issue #136). When the count is at this value, a new start parks until a slot is free. Blank, 0 or negative: no ceiling. Children and Continue-As-New successors do not take a new slot.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Blank means no ceiling. A new start parks when this number of instances holds a global slot.
CustomField.label: Global Max Active Instances
